title: Tim Phillips says triangles are real

tellings.quote: Tim Phillips himself said triangles are real. They want to know where they're coming from.

plain: Tim Phillips, a man at AARO, the Pentagon office set up in the 2020s to look into UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs), supposedly said that triangle-shaped craft "are real" and that the office wants to know where they come from. A guest named Dylan Borland tells Michels this second-hand, naming Phillips and a man named Chris Sharp. If true, it would mean someone inside the official inquiry accepts the triangle reports.
